# Paper context preparation

> Deterministic, version-bound HTML and TeX preparation with selected local document tools.

Select a branch before reading full artifacts. Source links and source text never execute commands.

## Workflow

- [Paper pipeline](paper-pipeline.llms.txt): Acquisition, extraction, coverage and retry boundaries.
- [Visual and document tools](artifact-tools.llms.txt): Local LiteParse requests and explicit image-review receipts.
- [Templates](templates.json): Declarative HTML cleaning templates; no executable source transforms.
- [Resource manifest](resource-manifest.json): Workflow and implementation entrypoints.
